quotes.text: PromptPay for US-based Stripe accounts is in private preview.
You receive confirmation from Stripe instantly when they complete the payment.
After a customer successfully completes a transaction, any attempt to use the same QR code again can result in having the funds deducted from their bank account.

findings: November documents a private-preview waitlist for US-based Stripe accounts. Stripe reviews the email application and contacts eligible applicants. TH remains the sole country in the standard business-location list and in the same-date cross-method matrix; Thailand buyers and THB presentment remain explicit.

Both captures document customer-initiated payment from a participating Thai bank app, authorization after QR scan, and instant Stripe confirmation upon completion. Manual capture is unsupported. Connect, full and partial refunds, and the documented product support restrictions carry forward.

Both captures disclose that Stripe emails the address supplied at PaymentIntent confirmation and that refund failure is possible if the buyer cannot provide the originating bank account number. Separately, reuse of a completed QR can debit the customer again. If Stripe receives excess funds, Stripe credits the merchant's Stripe balance and notifies it, and the merchant repays the customer outside Stripe.
The overview supports Elements with product-specific exclusions. The dated accept-a-payment guide's two displayed links scope that guide's UI paths.
substantive_changes: At new raw lines 71–81 Stripe adds a US-based Stripe-account private-preview email waitlist with eligibility review and conditional contact. The standard TH list is retained above it. The existing refund summary's categorical wording is an inherited fidelity correction.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain the 2026-05-06 raw source and its sole standard TH business-location bullet. Thailand and THB, customer bank authorization and instant completion confirmation, Connect, refunds, duplicate-payment ownership, descriptor, dispute and product constraints continue to be separately visible.
conflicts: The mapped summary at lines 13 and 17 and Real-Time Payments at lines 149 and 210 express TH-only merchant eligibility without a date or preview qualification. Preserve the May wording as historical and label the November TH entry and separate US private-preview application accurately.

Mapped summary line 21 and concept line 153 say the refund fails without the originating bank number. The captures say it might fail, with Stripe requesting the number at the email address supplied at PaymentIntent confirmation and automatically processing the refund after receiving the information.

Real-Time Payments line 163 says no Elements path, but the overview lists Elements in both captures. Qualify the two checkout/direct integration choices as guide scope and preserve the overview's product subscription/setup, Express Checkout Element, and mobile platform restrictions.
unresolved_questions: These captures leave actual US account eligibility or activation, connected-account enablement requirements, and payout timing open.

answers.Q1: https://docs.stripe.com/payments/promptpay documents PromptPay as a customer-initiated Thai real-time QR payment for Thailand customers in THB. A buyer selects PromptPay, scans the displayed QR in a participating Thai bank app, authorizes, and receives the completion notification. Stripe confirms to the merchant immediately on completion (new raw lines 7–49 and 83–95, old raw lines 6–48 and 70–83). Connect and full/partial refunds are supported; manual capture is unsupported and dispute support is marked “Not applicable.” Stripe still reviews irregular or unexpected/repeated payments and can contact or take other action (new raw lines 35–49 and 128–130, old raw lines 34–48 and 116–118). The standard business location remains TH (new raw lines 51–55, old raw lines 50–54). New raw lines 71–81 additionally document a US-based Stripe-account private-preview application via email waitlist, Stripe review, and contact if eligible. The standard November business location and customer country are TH and currency THB in the support matrix, line 68. Checkout has payment-mode support with setup/subscription modes excluded; Payment Links and Elements are listed, Express Checkout Element excluded, Mobile Payment Element iOS-only, and Invoices/Subscriptions use send_invoice. Stripe frontend products can select relevant methods after Dashboard enablement and the page links manual configuration (new raw lines 57–69 and 97–114, old raw lines 56–68 and 85–102). A Dashboard/API refund prompts Stripe to email the address supplied at PaymentIntent confirmation; the customer provides the account number of the original paying bank account, after which Stripe automatically processes the refund. Omission might cause failure. For repeated use of a completed QR, a second debit can occur. If Stripe receives excess, it credits the merchant's Stripe balance and notifies the merchant, who refunds the buyer outside Stripe. The fixed Stripe Thailand descriptor appears with the amount and reference on the statement (new raw lines 116–130, old raw lines 104–118). source-stripe-promptpay.md captures the main May behavior, but lines 13 and 17 need the dated eligibility distinction and line 21 needs the email timing and conditional refund outcome. Its promptpay enum is supported by the separate November matrix row 297; the PayNow comparison has separate PayNow evidence at lines 185–187 of that method overview.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/promptpay, the substantive November addition is the application route for US-based Stripe accounts in private preview, conditional on Stripe review and eligible-applicant contact (new raw lines 71–81). Preserve TH as the May and November standard location and Thailand/THB as customer and presentment scope (old raw lines 14–20 and 50–54, new raw lines 15–21 and 51–55). The same-date matrix line 68 concerns the standard business/customer listing; the US waitlist does not establish general US availability, approval or activation. Payment-flow SVG locations and spacing/heading changes are presentational, with the same four steps (old raw lines 70–83, new raw lines 83–95). The Elements quickstart destination change is navigation (old raw lines 85–90, new raw lines 97–102), and the manual acceptance link stays in place. source-stripe-promptpay.md should preserve the 2026-05-06 raw link and add the 2026-11-07 raw link, dating the merchant eligibility distinction. Inherited corrections are the conditional refund failure and the email at PaymentIntent confirmation (old raw lines 104–106, new raw lines 116–118). Anchor the reciprocal Real-Time Payments route at its PromptPay detail and Raw Sources backlink, and refresh the Stripe index overview entry at line 362 through wiki/index.md line 7. Retain the acceptance sibling at the Stripe index and concept backlinks, and qualify the concept's two-route integration statement as guide scope, since Elements product support persists at old raw lines 56–68 and new raw lines 57–69. When preserving the PayNow contrast, use PayNow's own November overview for rejection of further attempts on a completed QR and keep PromptPay's external customer make-good separate from its ordinary Stripe refunds (old raw lines 104–114, new raw lines 116–126).
